name: How do I choose bathroom tile that is durable in a wet climate?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose bathroom tile and grout that stay durable in a heavily used bathroom?
mainEntity.text: How do I choose bathroom tile and grout that stay durable in a heavily used bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Durability depends on both material selection and installation quality. For a heavily used bathroom, homeowners should look at tile size, surface texture, slip resistance, water exposure, and how much maintenance they want to do over time. Shower walls, floors, and accent areas may need different products because they face different levels of moisture and wear. Grout choice matters too, since some options are easier to maintain than others. Even the best tile can fail if the substrate, waterproofing, or slope is wrong, so the installation method is just as important as the finish. In a luxury remodel, it is worth asking how the contractor handles waterproofing, movement joints, and sealed transitions around niches, benches, and curbless entries. The goal is not just a beautiful bathroom on day one, but a surface system that stays tight, easy to clean, and resistant to staining or cracking over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose tile based on slip resistance, water exposure, maintenance, and installation quality, not just appearance. Durable bathroom finishes depend on proper waterproofing, correct substrate prep, and grout or sealant choices that match the shower or floor location.
